title: Furtherness in finite topological spaces
summary: In this paper, we introduce a novel distance-like notion of furtherness for finite topological spaces, demonstrating that every finite space can be viewed as an asymmetric pseudometric space. In particular, we show that every finite T0 space is asymmetric metric space. The topology induced by the forward balls coincides with the original topology of the space, while the backward balls induce the opposite topology.
